components.name: warp.dev
components.description: warp.dev is the public website for Warp.

components.name: Account, team, and data services
components.description: Sign in, use SSO, authenticate the CLI, and manage API tokens. Save, retrieve, and share conversations, transcripts, and Warp Drive objects. Manage members, permissions, team settings, subscriptions, credits, and usage.

components.name: Live sessions and agent control
components.description: Join shared sessions, watch live output, send follow-up messages, receive agent responses and control active agent conversations.

components.name: Cloud agent execution
components.description: Start and run cloud agents, including environment preparation and worker allocation.

components.name: Warp agent harness
components.description: Execute the core agent loop accounting for model inference, tool/command invocation, context assembly and compaction, conversation state, and more.

components.name: Automations and integrations
components.description: Run agents from schedules, custom webhooks, and supported integrations such as Slack, GitHub, and Linear.

components.name: Web app
components.description: Open and use the factory web application and all key functionality (factory chat, automation management, agent management).

components.name: Downloads and updates
components.description: Download Warp and the CLI, check for releases, and retrieve application updates.
